name: Holographic Defocus Blur Matching
aliases: Determining the diameter of the blur circle
definition: A method to calculate the maximum propagation distance of a hologram ($\Delta z$) and the diameter of a blur circle of a human eye ($CoC_{eye}$) in units of display pixels, to ensure the holographic defocus blur matches the optical defocus blur of the human eye.
summary: Holographic Defocus Blur Matching calculates hologram propagation and eye blur circle sizes to link spatial light modulator constraints with human pupil physiology for perceptually correct depth cues.
